info.title: Aurora Binaural API
info.description: Aurora Binaural spatial audio processing HTTP API (docs/plan.md Section 10). Provides streaming asset uploads, persistent SQLite asynchronous job queue with Idempotency-Key protection, block-boundary cancellation, and timeline-verified outputs.

get.description: Liveness check endpoint. Never exposes internal filesystem paths.

get.summary: Check task storage, worker heartbeat, and HRTF dataset readiness
get.description: Readiness check verifying SQLite database, active Worker heartbeat, and HRTF data.

get.summary: List spatial presets, parameter ranges, and versions
get.description: Return built-in spatial presets, parameter ranges, and version metadata.

post.summary: Stream-upload an audio asset and return asset ID and probe metadata
post.description: Stream-upload an audio asset, enforcing upload size and duration limits.

post.summary: Create an asynchronous spatial rendering job (HTTP 202)
post.description: Create an asynchronous job with `Idempotency-Key` deduplication and conflict protection.

post.summary: Queue a source-timeline excerpt with a BS.1770 matched original/effect pair

get.summary: Query job status, progress, result metadata, and error

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job (idempotent)
post.description: Idempotently cancel a job. Terminal jobs (`succeeded`, `failed`, `canceled`) remain unchanged.

get.summary: Download rendered output audio for a succeeded job
get.description: Stream-download the rendered audio file, returning HTTP 410 if the result has expired.

get.summary: Download the loudness-matched original side of a completed preview

200.description: BS.1770 loudness-matched original excerpt (float32 stereo WAV).

get.summary: Download JSON conversion report for a succeeded job
get.description: Return the structured JSON `ConversionReport`, or HTTP 410 if expired.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: Perceptual effect strength in [0.0, 1.0]. Mapped to upmix width, ambient ratio, early reflections, and DRR offset. Dry/wet mixing is forbidden. When 0.0, spatial DSP is bypassed. Defaults to the selected preset's default_strength.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Explicit 32-bit unsigned seed for deterministic FDN delay lines and decorrelation filters.

output.description: Output format, container, sample rate, bit depth, and bitrate settings.

timing.description: Timeline synchronization mode and reverb tail handling policy.

AuroraParams.title: AuroraParams
AuroraParams.description:
Unified parameter model shared by CLI, Web GUI, and HTTP API (docs/plan.md Sections 9 & 10).

Supports both standalone render parameter validation and full `POST /v1/jobs` payloads:
```json
{
  "api_version": "v1",
  "mode": "enhance",
  "input": {"asset_id": "asset_example"},
  "preset": {"id": "room", "version": "1"},
  "strength": 0.4,
  "seed": 20261016,
  "output": {"format": "wav", "sample_rate": 48000, "bit_depth": 24},
  "timing": {"mode": "preserve", "tail": "trim"}
}
```

name.title: Name
name.default: SADIE II D1 (configured; not applied by stub)

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: Uploaded asset identifier for HTTP API jobs (e.g. 'asset_example').

path.title: Path
path.description: Local filesystem path for CLI / local worker jobs.

InputSpec.title: InputSpec
InputSpec.description: Input reference for HTTP API jobs or CLI invocations (docs/plan.md Section 10).

cancel_requested.title: Cancel Requested
cancel_requested.description: True if cancellation was requested (transitional sub-field when status='running').

canceling.title: Canceling
canceling.description: True when status=='running' and cancel_requested==True (Section 10 transitional sub-field).

integrated_lufs.title: Integrated Lufs
integrated_lufs.description: Integrated loudness in LUFS per ITU-R BS.1770-4 (None if silent).

true_peak_dbtp.title: True Peak Dbtp
true_peak_dbtp.description: Maximum true peak in dBTP (None if pure digital silence / -inf).

is_silent.title: Is Silent
is_silent.description: True if signal is below absolute gating threshold (-70 LUFS / -inf dBTP).

LoudnessMetrics.title: LoudnessMetrics
LoudnessMetrics.description: ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness and true peak measurements via ffmpeg ebur128 filter.

OutputContainer.title: OutputContainer
OutputContainer.description: Supported output audio container formats (docs/plan.md Section 4.1).

format.description: Output format: 'wav' (PCM), 'm4a' (AAC-LC in M4A container), or 'mp3' (MPEG-1 Layer III).

container.description: Output container ('wav', 'm4a', 'mp3'). Automatically derived from format if omitted.

sample_rate.title: Sample Rate
sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz (44100, 48000, or 96000). Internal engine runs at 48000 Hz.

bit_depth.title: Bit Depth
bit_depth.description: PCM bit depth for WAV output (16, 24, or 32). Ignored/null for lossy M4A/MP3 outputs.

bitrate_kbps.title: Bitrate Kbps
bitrate_kbps.description: Target bitrate in kbps for lossy codecs (M4A/MP3). Defaults to 256 kbps when encoding lossy formats.

OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec
OutputSpec.description:
Output encoding and container specification (docs/plan.md Section 4.1, 8, 10).

Explicitly separates audio format/codec from container per Section 4.1.
Raw .aac is not permitted as an output container because ADTS lacks edit-list
gapless metadata; AAC output always uses the M4A (MP4) container.

PresetMetadata.title: PresetMetadata
PresetMetadata.description: Versioned preset metadata returned by `aurora presets` and `GET /v1/presets`.

id.description: Preset identifier from presets/*.toml; default V2. room is the classic route B.

version.title: Version
version.description: Explicit preset version string for deterministic reproduction.

PresetSpec.title: PresetSpec
PresetSpec.description: Preset selection and version specification (docs/plan.md Section 6.10 & 10).

PreviewReport.title: PreviewReport
PreviewReport.description: Matched excerpt verification; all offsets refer to the source timeline.

PreviewRequest.title: PreviewRequest
PreviewRequest.description: POST /v1/previews request. Always emits a matched stereo float32 WAV pair.

PreviewSpec.title: PreviewSpec
PreviewSpec.description: Source-timeline excerpt; duration is bounded before creating a queue entry.

database.title: Database
database.description: True if SQLite task store is reachable and initialized.

worker.title: Worker
worker.description: True if at least one Worker has an active heartbeat.

hrtf_data.title: Hrtf Data
hrtf_data.description: True if fixed-version HRTF .sofa data is present.

ReadyResponseModel.title: ReadyResponseModel
ReadyResponseModel.description: Response model for `GET /ready` (strictly no internal paths).

engine_latency_samples.title: Engine Latency Samples
engine_latency_samples.description: Engine lookahead/processing latency compensated in samples.

engine_tail_samples.title: Engine Tail Samples
engine_tail_samples.description: Engine reverb tail length in samples.

extra_tail_samples_kept.title: Extra Tail Samples Kept
extra_tail_samples_kept.description: Extra reverb tail samples retained in output (0 when tail='trim').

input_samples.title: Input Samples
input_samples.description: Decoded input sample frames per channel.

expected_output_samples.title: Expected Output Samples
expected_output_samples.description: Expected output sample frames per channel at output sample rate.

decoded_readback_samples.title: Decoded Readback Samples
decoded_readback_samples.description: Actual sample frames per channel decoded on default readback.

raw_decoded_samples.title: Raw Decoded Samples
raw_decoded_samples.description: Raw packet sample frames per channel when ignoring container edit-list / Xing tags.

sample_diff.title: Sample Diff
sample_diff.description: decoded_readback_samples - expected_output_samples (0 means exact timeline match).

raw_sample_diff.title: Raw Sample Diff
raw_sample_diff.description: raw_decoded_samples - expected_output_samples (includes raw priming + trailing padding).

codec_priming_samples.title: Codec Priming Samples
codec_priming_samples.description: Measured encoder/decoder start delay (priming) in raw stream before container compensation.

codec_trailing_padding_samples.title: Codec Trailing Padding Samples
codec_trailing_padding_samples.description: Measured frame-completion trailing padding in raw stream before container compensation.

residual_priming_shift_samples.title: Residual Priming Shift Samples
residual_priming_shift_samples.description: Residual impulse/onset shift in samples after container gapless compensation.

compensation_strategy.title: Compensation Strategy
compensation_strategy.description: Applied timeline and codec delay compensation strategy.

sync_within_tolerance.title: Sync Within Tolerance
sync_within_tolerance.description: True if abs(sample_diff) <= tolerance_samples and residual shift is within tolerance.

sync_warning.title: Sync Warning
sync_warning.description: Warning message advising WAV 48kHz/24bit if sync tolerance is exceeded or FFmpeg < 7.

TimelineVerification.title: TimelineVerification
TimelineVerification.description: Timeline synchronization and codec priming/padding verification results (Section 8 & 10).

mode.description: Timeline synchronization mode. 'preserve' guarantees exact sample alignment.

tail.description: Reverb tail strategy: 'trim' keeps exact input sample length with a short fade-out; 'preserve' appends tail_samples.

fade_out_ms.title: Fade Out Ms
fade_out_ms.description: Short fade-out duration in milliseconds applied at the end when tail='trim' to prevent clicks.

TimingSpec.title: TimingSpec
TimingSpec.description: Timeline synchronization and reverb tail policy (docs/plan.md Section 8 & 10).
